title: Using AI doesn’t mean AI made my game.. What’s Your Opinion?
author: MrfisherStudio
selftext:
Hey everyone!  
I’ve been working on my game WES for quite some time now, and recently I’ve been sharing it in different Reddit communities.  
One thing I’ve noticed is that as soon as some people hear AI was involved, they immediately assume the whole game was made by AI and I did nothing.  
And honestly, that’s a bit frustrating.  
I’ve spent countless hours working on this game. Coming up with ideas, designing mechanics, testing, fixing problems, changing things that didn’t work, and sometimes starting all over again.  
Yes, I use AI. I also use Godot, different tools, tutorials, and whatever else helps me get things done.  
But since when does using a tool mean you’re not doing the work?  
AI doesn’t decide what kind of game I want to make. It doesn’t know what I have in my head, what feels right to me, or what I want players to experience. Those are my decisions.  
I’m not saying my game is perfect. Far from it. I’m still learning, and there’s a lot I want to improve.  
I have absolutely no problem with criticism. Actually, some of the feedback I’ve received here on Reddit has helped me make the game better.  
But I think there’s a big difference between criticizing someone’s work and dismissing all their effort just because they used AI somewhere in the process.  
I’m proud of what I’ve built so far. Not because it’s perfect, but because I know how much work I’ve put into it.  
Anyway, I’m curious how other developers here feel about this. Have you experienced the same thing?  
And I’d genuinely love to see what you guys are working on too. :)

comments.author: minotalen
comments.body: unholy mix of assets and styles, almost scary

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body:
That looks 100% AI made and is one of the reason we get so much hate. Nothing looks natural or like it belongs. Looks completely synthetic and lacks any heart. This needs a LOT of work. 

  
Please dont share this in its current state as it only makes it harder for the rest of us.

comments.author: Big_Presentation2786
comments.body:
If your game lacks gameplay- it's slop.

That's all you need to get right.. that's literally it

comments.author: MrfisherStudio
comments.body:
I understand what you’re saying, and I appreciate the feedback. I know the visuals still need work, and I’m not pretending otherwise.  
But I don’t really agree that I should stop sharing my game just because it’s not good enough yet. I’m sharing it because I’m still developing it, and feedback is part of that process.  
I’m not representing every AI developer here. I’m just one guy working on his own game, trying to make it better.  
And honestly, I think we should be helping each other improve, not telling people to stop sharing what they’re working on.

replies.author: FailedGradAdmissions
replies.body:
The main issue you have in your game is the assets are not cohesive, either get an asset pack or regenerate all the art in the same style. Obviously easier said than done, but gpt image can be consistent as long as you give it a reference.

So choose a style, then give it to images, like redraw this chicken on this dog style….

replies.author: MrfisherStudio
replies.body:
Thanks a lot! This is actually really helpful feedback. I think you’re right, I probably focused too much on individual assets and didn’t pay enough attention to how they all look together. Definitely something I’ll work on.  
But honestly, they look so cute in the actual game 😅😅 I know it’s hard to believe from the screenshots, but trust me, when you’re playing it feels completely different haha.  
Anyway, really appreciate you taking the time to explain it! :)

replies.author: Upbeat_Ingenuity_745
replies.body:
You got this, keep on fine tuning it, and keep on posting update videos to your own content.

Its your game, be proud.

replies.author: MrfisherStudio
replies.body: Thank you so much :) You have no idea how much I appreciate this, Still a long way to go, but I’m definitely not giving up. Thanks again for the support! ❤️

replies.author: Three_Tails_Studio
replies.body: They ARENT assets. They are AI generated pictures. We all could make your entire "asset" list in 15 seconds. All you are doing is plopping down pictures.

replies.author: MrfisherStudio
replies.body:
Come on, you really think making a game is just putting pictures together? 😅  
Sure, generating an image takes seconds. Making it actually work in a game, building the mechanics, animations, interactions, balancing everything and making it fun to play is a completely different story.  
I respect your opinion on the visuals, but please don’t dismiss months of work as something anyone could do in 15 seconds. ❤️😅

replies.author: Three_Tails_Studio
replies.body: Keep at it. What you are showing us today looks like 1 day of work with Claude.

replies.author: MrfisherStudio
replies.body:
My bad, maybe you think what I showed is the actual game? 😅 It’s just a funny little scene I generated in like 5 seconds haha.  
The actual game is already on TestFlight and trust me, it looks and feels completely different when you play it.

replies.author: Three_Tails_Studio
replies.body: I will not trust you because I know better. Anyone can take pictures and place them on other pictures and the add a little movement. This is 1st grade quality work.

replies.author: MrfisherStudio
replies.body:
What were you expecting, GTA 7? 😂 Come on…  
I’m fine with criticism, no problem at all. But comments like yours can really discourage a lot of beginners who are just trying to create something.  
There’s a difference between giving feedback and putting someone’s work down. Just saying.

replies.author: Three_Tails_Studio
replies.body:
"Using AI doesn’t mean AI made my game" ALL YOU HAVE USED IT AI. You are lying to us because you think we wont see straight through you. YOU need a dose of reality and this is what that is. 

  
This would be a good AI game maybe 2 years ago .. you are going to have to do ALOT better with where AI is today. Like I said, this looks like 1 days work with Opus IF THAT. 

  
I have ZERO issue with AI in gaming. ZERO. I have issue with this smoke you are trying to blow. You deserve to be called out.

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: Even your website is a total one shot prompt. No soul, no identity. You take the first thing your LLM sends you and publish it. Take your time and CREATE something. YOU are doing nothing and letting your LLM produce crap. I mean .. your game is called where EMBERS stay. EMBER is one of the most overused AI names. You honesty think we are all stupid .. its the only conclusion I can come to.
